maneuvers.name: Ambush
maneuvers.description: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll, unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

maneuvers.name: Bait and Switch
maneuvers.description: When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and the creature is willing and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

maneuvers.name: Commander's Strike
maneuvers.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct one of your companions to strike.

maneuvers.name: Commanding Presence
maneuvers.description: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the roll.

maneuvers.name: Disarming Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to disarm the target.

maneuvers.name: Distracting Strike
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract the target.

maneuvers.name: Evasive Footwork
maneuvers.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Disengage action.

maneuvers.name: Feinting Attack
maneuvers.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of yourself as your target.

maneuvers.name: Goading Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you.

maneuvers.name: Lunging Attack
maneuvers.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Dash action.

maneuvers.name: Maneuvering Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into another position.

maneuvers.name: Menacing Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to frighten the target.

maneuvers.name: Parry
maneuvers.description: When another creature damages you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your Superiority Die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

maneuvers.name: Precision Attack
maneuvers.description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll that die, and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.

maneuvers.name: Pushing Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to drive the target back.

maneuvers.name: Rally
maneuvers.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion.

maneuvers.name: Riposte
maneuvers.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack roll with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the creature.

maneuvers.name: Sweeping Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to damage another creature.

maneuvers.name: Tactical Assessment
maneuvers.description: When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.

maneuvers.name: Trip Attack
maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the attack's damage roll.
